search-summary.boundaries: Public 1C methods using a ready query vector: native includes DB read and deserialize; Qdrant includes 1C HTTP transport, LAN NAS query, payload parsing, DB text rehydration and policy checks. COM invocation time included equally, result conversion excluded.

upload-sweep-summary.transport: Python urllib REST, proxy bypass, wait=true, bounded ThreadPoolExecutor; not a 1C/BSP queue implementation
upload-sweep-summary.cancelled_pilot: 256-point serial variant was cancelled after over 180 s without a completed result; only owned Python helper stopped, same point values, 1C/EDT unaffected. Not included in timing statistics.

dataset-proof.generator: Python Random(seed), integer [-500,500]/1000, L2 normalized, no semantic model

qdrant_changes: Query results read from 1C in one batch; stored vectors are not read/deserialized for rehydration
Orphan/policy reconciliation reads references and policies in one batch
Queue keeps per-record reads to preserve up-to-date policy and isolate vector deserialization failures
